description: Taseli's work plan for the business, read only: the active plan (stage, goals, the owner's rules it follows, what Taseli does now and next and why, its if-then branches, when it is looked at again), or a plain note that none is built yet; plus the follow-up steps waiting (what, why, when it is checked next, whether it acts by itself or only tells) and steps done, blocked or expired in the last 30 days. Every line carries its id (`item`, a waiting step's `step`). Useful for 'what's the plan?', 'what's next?', 'what are you waiting for?', 'when do we add budget?', 'what did the plan do?'.

account.description: An ad account's name, to look at one account; omit for all of them.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: get_plan

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
